name: Remotive
tagline: Free public JSON API for remote-only job listings from Remotive.
description: Remotive provides a public unauthenticated JSON GET API for active remote job listings, with category, company_name, search, and limit filters. Results are delayed by 24 hours. Reuse requires Remotive attribution and backlinks, and submitting listings to third-party job sites is prohibited.

auth.details: Public job-list endpoints require no authentication. No API key signup for basic listing access.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public API listings are delayed by 24 hours. Remotive advises no more than 4 requests per day and blocks clients exceeding 2 requests per minute.

rate_limits: Maximum 4 requests per day is advised; more than 2 requests per minute will be blocked.
use_cases: filter remote openings by category or search term
build a remote-job aggregator or alert bot
enrich a careers page with live Remotive listings
